messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — final prep for Polaris Dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need explicit ✅ on quota bump, autoscale thresholds, and the load-test window. Who's taking ownership of the smoke profile?
Jordan K: I patched the quota request (3x baseline) and submitted to billing for signoff. Expect approval by EOD today, but leaving a buffer in case they ask for SI.
Leo (CS): Re: smoke profile — I can own the 20m warmup + 40m soak. Will run the script from my laptop and kick off from the ops runner. Plan: 0→30RPS in 5m, hold 30m, then spike to 120RPS for 5m.
Nina - CS Eng: Sounds good. A couple of asks: 1) confirm autoscale lower bound (min pods) so we don't scale to zero; 2) add a slow-start prefix cache priming step (we saw cold KV misses last time).
Jordan K: Autoscale min is set to 2 workers per pool right now. I can change to 4 during the test window and revert after.
Maya R: @Jordan K please set to 4 by 08:50 PT and add a note in the runbook when you change it. @Leo (CS) you'll coordinate with SRE on the script?
Leo (CS): Yep. I'll post the exact load command in this thread 20m before start.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: capacity-pool/polaris updated -> desired_replicas=4 by jordan-k (10:12 UTC) :rocket:
Jordan K: ops-bot confirmed the desired_replicas change.
Leo (CS): Load command (example):
```
hey -c 200 -q 200 -m POST https://polaris.rw-inference/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"<warmup>"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -t 00:45:00
```
I'll use the custom ramp: --ramp 0:00:00=0 --ramp 0:05:00=30 --hold 0:35:00=30 --spike 0:40:00=120 --cool 0:45:00=10
Maya R: Reminder: keep SLOs in mind. 95p latency target <= 250ms token op; error rate <= 0.5% during soak. If we cross 1.5% for 2 consecutive minutes, abort and roll traffic back.
Nina - CS Eng: For rollback: plan is to shift 50% traffic to fallback region (eu-west-1) then reduce to 0 over 10m. We have the routing policy ready.
Jordan K: Noted. I'll prepare the rollback commands and hand them to oncall.
Leo (CS): Quick check — KMS key rotation is scheduled tomorrow 02:00 PT. That won't affect the bring-up window, right?
Maya R: Good catch. KMS rotation should be independent; ops confirmed no rotation on the customer key for Polaris.
ops-bot: Alert: scheduled KMS rotation (global) at 02:00 PT — status: no impact to polaris-key (verified)
Jordan K: Billing signed off. Quota bump approved.
Maya R: Great. Final owner list: Quota & env changes = Jordan, Load tests & runbook = Leo, Rollback & routing = Nina, CS oversight = Maya.
Leo (CS): I'll paste the short runbook snippet here before we close:
```
- 08:30 PT: pre-check health dashboard + token burn rate
- 08:40 PT: set desired_replicas=4 (Jordan)
- 08:50 PT: warm cache priming (small prefix requests)
- 09:00 PT: start soak loadtest (Leo)
- 09:45 PT: spike test (Leo)
- 09:50 PT: analyze traces, confirm SLOs (Maya)
- 10:00 PT: shift partial live traffic if green (Nina)
- 10:15 PT: revert desired_replicas -> 2
```
Maya R: Perfect. I'll post this into the Polaris onboarding playbook and notify the CE team. Anyone wants to edit the runbook before I push?
Jordan K: LGTM :thumbsup:
Nina - CS Eng: LGTM. I'll be on-call during the window.
Leo (CS): All set from my side. Will post a short post-mortem 1h after test.
Maya R: Thanks all — let's reconvene in #customer-success 30m before start for final green check. :white_check_mark:
